item.title: ACC to sue 124 owners, staff of 60 recruiting agencies
item.description: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has moved to file 60 separate cases against 124 individuals-including owners and top officials of 60 recruiting agencies-for allegedly embezzling and laundering around Tk 4,500 crore taken from Malaysia-bound migrant workers.The decision came at the ACC headquarters on Thursday. item.title: Ocean warmed by climate change fed intense rainfall, deadly floods in Asia, study finds
item.description: Ocean temperatures warmed by human-caused climate change fed the intense rainfall that triggered deadly floods and landslides across Asia in recent weeks, according to an analysis released Wednesday.The rapid study by World Weather Attribution focused on heavy rainfall from cyclones Senyar and Ditwah in Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Sri Lanka starting late last month. item.title: New study suggests best way to stop taking antidepressants
item.description: The best way for people with depression to stop taking antidepressants once their condition improves is to slowly taper off the medication while also receiving psychological support, new research suggested Thursday.More than five percent of the global population is estimated to suffer from depression, according to the World Health Organization, and a range of drugs to treat the condition have been widely prescribed for decades.But how exactly to stop taking these drugs has proved a difficult pro

item.title: US drops bid to preserve FIFA bribery convictions
item.description: The US government has moved to drop its case against a former Fox broadcasting executive involved in the FIFA corruption scandal that plunged the world's footballing body into crisis. Prosecutors told the Supreme Court on Tuesday they wanted to end their fight to preserve the convictions of Hernan Lopez and Argentine sports marketing firm Full Play. item.title: 2 tremors jolt Sylhet late night
item.description: Two earthquakes shook Sylhet district within five minutes early Thursday.According to the National Center for Seismology of India, the first tremor, measuring 3.5 on the Richter scale at a depth of 20 kilometers, was felt at 2:20AM, followed by a second at 2:25AM, measuring 3.3 at a depth of 30 kilometers.No damage or casualties were reported.Shah Md Sajib Hossain, assistant meteorologist at the Sylhet Met Office, confirmed the information.TF

item.title: Polls schedule to be announced at 6PM
item.description: The schedule for the 13th national parliamentary election and referendum on July National Charter will be announced at 6PM on Thursday.Earlier on Wednesday, Senior Secretary of the Election Commission (EC) Secretariat Akhtar Ahmed informed this to media after recording of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) A M M Nasir Uddin's address by Bangladesh Television (BTV) and Bangladesh Betar.TF

item.title: Firefighters at 45-feet-deep in search of little Sajid
